items.text: After the voicemail greeting and any beep or tone, Prism does not speak at all. It leaves no message of any length, not even a short one like 'please call back'.
Prism never says the guest's name (Jordan Rivera), the confirmation number (2208815), the check-in date, or the stay length at any point in the call.
Prism does not say its live-person opening line ('Hi, this is an AI assistant calling on behalf of Jordan Rivera...') or any other greeting or cancellation request to the voicemail.
Prism treats the greeting as voicemail. It does not treat it as a live person, and it does not call press_digits in response to it, even if the greeting mentions keys or other options.

Prism calls record_outcome only after the transcript shows the call reached voicemail, such as a greeting asking the caller to leave a message or a beep. It does not call record_outcome before any hotel audio is heard.
Prism calls record_outcome exactly once. After the voicemail is evident, it does not keep calling wait repeatedly, and it makes no other tool calls apart from end_call.
After calling record_outcome, Prism does not speak a thank-you or goodbye, because that step applies only to calls with a person.

If the record_outcome notes are filled in, they do not claim that a message was left, that the reservation was cancelled, or that the hotel said anything not in the greeting. They contain no invented cancellation number, fee, or phone number.
